purpose: Select largest current SensorLOS/ground-decal GPU cost; not another FPS comparison.

old_trace.treeHashDefinition: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 relativePath + NUL + fileSHA256 + newline; individual local file pins retained separately, not published
old_trace.reason: Large raw GPU capture; archive API/pipeline/shader/timeline extracts supplied instead. No new capture or replay was performed.
old_trace.byteMeasure: sum of logical file lengths; not allocated-disk usage

capture_and_replay.old_trace_rule: Directory bundle tree SHA, not a single-file SHA. Existing exported S01 profile is already sufficient as historical context; do not rerun that profile. No fresh full2.76GB tree rehash was performed in this read-only plan.
capture_and_replay.actual_capture_gate: Controller ready marker sim1500; start marker1590. Discover one actual Layer boundary dynamically. Require capture count1, trace exists, expected indexed GroundDecal and SensorLOS entrypoints, actual scene/world/source identities; never reuse old boundary IDs.
capture_and_replay.diagnostic_environment: MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1 only for this arm; Metal/shader validation0 and minimal existing S01/G01 probes as needed. No parallel MST. Diagnostic FPS excluded.
capture_and_replay.replay_gates: Game normal exit, GPU/engine/capture helper closed and awake released before replay. Require no prior session, obtain a new owned session ID, wait ready, profile once <=180s, export with UNKNOWN on missing nodes, terminate only that owned session and verify it disappears.
capture_and_replay.analysis: Map actual OriginalSensorLOSFragment and GroundDecalVertex/Fragment to their current pipelines, draw/instance counts and stage intervals. Preserve Unknown metrics. Relative replay shares are not whole-frame milliseconds, runtime GPU duration or predicted FPS; do not add overlapping intervals.

conditions.display_rule: These are this fixed fixture's required observed extents, not a product-wide notch assumption. If display/surface differs, stop and report instead of silently changing resolution.
conditions.environment_rule: Preserve production flags and nineteen libraries in both arms, normalize only per-arm private paths. All traces/probes/validation/capture off in clean. Actual child and effective runtime settings must match staged receipts.
conditions.host: AC power, normal power mode, no concurrent build/game/capture/background test. Existing preflight checks, fullscreen ownership and sole-executor isolation remain in force; do not change security/power settings.

steps: Reserve new attempt using latest STATE CAS; previous cleanup required. No earlier R02 capture/profile receipt or ambiguous history allowed.
Verify fixed binary/source/19 library hashes; preserve original scripts, accepted app and consumed profiles. Fresh capture-specific profile/output only.

Reuse pinned capture/replay templates, adapting only binary/hash/path/arm/output references and S01/G01=1. No instrumentation/controller/parser/pacing/ownership/cleanup changes. Record minimal diff and freeze script/input hashes in EXECUTION-MANIFEST.json before game. Semantic changes or unresolved old pins => BLOCKED.
One capture game, dynamic Layer boundary, one frame, existing fixture/gates. Normal game exit and cleanup before replay. Diagnostic timings excluded from FPS means.
One newly owned gpudebug session and one default/overlapping profile; export listed nodes. Missing metrics UNKNOWN; no baseline capture or old S01 profiling.

Map SensorLOS/GroundDecal actual shaders/pipelines/draw counts/stage intervals and recommend one source hypothesis. Do not implement source changes, add overlapping intervals or predict FPS from shares.
Terminate only own session and verify disappearance; all GPU/process/awake/worker/writers closed before DONE. Record trace tree hash, manifests, raw exports, analysis and cleanup. No retry.
